name: criterion-6
text: Criterion 6 (O-1A 6, EB-1A vi): authorship of scholarly articles in professional journals or major media.
Counts: a published paper or benchmark (C6-scholarly); articles in trade publications; talks at major conferences as comparable evidence (D-talk-comparable).
Needs attorney: a talk not shown to be at a major conference (C6-talk-not-major).
Rejected: personal blog and LinkedIn posts.
